item.title: Nobody Suspects the TV - From an Open ADB Port to Network Proxy via Chisel
item.description: In this blog, I show how an unauthenticated Android Debug Bridge port on a Smart TV gave me an instant root shell on the device, and how I turned that shell into a covert SOCKS proxy using chisel, routing my network traffic through a television set sitting on the network.

item.title: Hiding Behind a CCTV - Turning a Hikvision RCE into a Covert Network Proxy
item.description: In this blog, I show how a single unauthenticated vulnerability in a Hikvision CCTV camera gave me not just a root shell on the device, but a covert network proxy, routing my traffic through the camera so every packet appeared to come from a surveillance device instead of my machine.

item.title: The NAS Nobody Patched - From Unauthenticated RCE to Network Proxy via WD MyCloud
item.description: In this blog, I walk through how an unauthenticated command injection in a WD MyCloud NAS gave me a reverse shell as root, how I bootstrapped a persistent SSH backdoor on a device that didn't even have SSH running, and how I turned that NAS into a covert SOCKS proxy with a single SSH flag.
